execution: signal at the close of day t, order fills at the close of day t+1 (cost 10bp per side on traded notional); monthly rules decide at the last trading day's close and fill at the next close; TOM/HAL use trade closes fixed by the calendar
cash: 13-week T-bill (^IRX, previous close) accrued per 365 calendar days as in style_combo.run_backtest; long sample: TB3MS of the previous month / 252 per trading day

windows.rolling_starts: first trading day of each January 2000..2023 to END
windows.dca_windows: 120 monthly contributions from the first trading day of the month; terminal = last trading day of the 120th month; complete months only

rules.B0: SPY buy-and-hold (dividend-adjusted); fully invested from the fill after the window-start close
rules.S2: half-trend: 100% SPY while weekly close > rising 30-week mean, 50% after a weekly close below it (position_rules.rule_stage_blend)
rules.S1: trend leverage: 1.5x SPY while weekly close > 200-day mean, re-levered at month ends, else cash (position_rules.rule_trend_leverage)
rules.F10: Faber: month-end close > mean of the last 10 month-end closes -> 100% SPY, else cash; fill next close
rules.DM-cash: Antonacci absolute momentum: month-end SPY trailing 12-month total return > trailing 12-month compounded T-bill -> 100% SPY, else cash
rules.DM-IEF: as DM-cash, but the off state holds the bond (IEF from 2002-07-30; before that a synthetic bond from DGS10)
rules.GTT: growth-trend timing (monthly): out only if the month-end close < 10-month SMA AND the latest published UNRATE (month m-1 at month-end m) > its 12-month mean of available values; else 100% SPY
rules.VT-1.0: volatility target: weight = min(1.0, 0.15 / realized vol), realized vol = std of the last 21 daily log returns x sqrt(252); fill next close only if |target - actual weight| > 0.10
rules.VT-1.5: as VT-1.0 with cap 1.5 (borrowing at T-bill + 1.5%)
rules.F10xVT: VT-1.0 target when F10 is on, else 0; same 0.10 no-trade band
rules.TOM: turn of month: invested from the close of the 2nd-to-last trading day of a month to the close of the 3rd trading day of the next month (last day's and first 3 days' returns)
rules.HAL: Halloween: 100% SPY from the close of the last trading day of October to the close of the last trading day of April; else cash
rules.RSI2: Connors RSI(2): enter when close > 200-day SMA and Wilder RSI(2) < 10; exit when close > 5-day SMA; fill next close; cash otherwise
rules.F_w: fixed SPY weight equal to the strategy's average weight, rebalanced at month ends, rest in T-bills
rules.SD1: smart DCA (DCA lens only): contributions 1 unit each month; DD = SPY drawdown from running max at the previous close; DD > -10%: invest 0.8 and reserve 0.2; -20% < DD <= -10%: invest 1 + 50% of reserve; DD <= -20%: invest 1 + 100% of reserve; invested money in SPY, reserve in T-bills

dca_lens.contribution: 1 unit on the first trading day of every month, 2000-01 to 2026-10
dca_lens.account: V_t = sum(units bought up to t) x NAV_t; units bought = (1 - 10bp) / NAV at the contribution close

metrics.vol: std of daily returns x sqrt(252)
metrics.sharpe: mean(daily return - daily T-bill) / std(daily return - daily T-bill) x sqrt(252)
metrics.max_dd: min over time of NAV / running max - 1
metrics.avg_weight: mean end-of-day SPY weight over the window
metrics.trades_per_year: executions that change the position, excluding the first purchase
metrics.share_days_dd_below_20: share of days with NAV drawdown < -20%

verdict.sharpe_beats_hold: Sharpe > B0 in the main window AND in both segments AND in the long sample (1935-1999; GTT 1949-1999)
verdict.cost_flag: still true at 30bp per side in the main window (Sharpe and Calmar)
verdict.dca_flag: share of 10-year DCA windows with ratio > plain DCA ratio >= 60%
verdict.dm_ief_long: DM-IEF is not run on the long sample by spec; its long-sample condition is reported as n/a

interpretations: TOM/HAL: holding periods are the calendar windows as stated (trade closes fixed by the calendar); the rule decides one close earlier so the engine's next-close fill lands on the stated close. The calendar is passed explicitly and known in advance.
GTT holds 100% SPY before its first month-end decision (out requires both conditions to be known).
Sharpe denominator is the std of daily excess returns; CAGR uses calendar years (style_combo convention).
DCA cost of 10bp is applied to the whole contribution (the strategy NAV already contains its internal cash).
SD1 running max starts at the SPY cache start (1998-12-01).
VT: the 10bp band uses the actual SPY weight; the F10xVT exit can leave a residual <= 0.10 exposure when the band blocks it (rule kept literal).
RSI(2) uses Wilder smoothing via ewm(alpha=1/2), seeded at the first daily change.
Long sample: Jan 1934 uses its own TB3MS value (first observation); the Shiller dividend ends 2024-06, so the validation window ends there.
Post-publication: F10xVT uses 2017 (the later of its two components); TOM 1988 uses the composite series (constructed total return to 1999-12-31, SPY afterwards).
Long sample: the Shiller monthly dividend yield is applied per trading day (spec); UNRATE is the revised FRED series (limitation).
Timing placebo: the actual Sharpe in placebo.csv is computed in the same constant-cash framework as the shifted paths; CAGR and MaxDD are checked against band_timing.timing_placebo.
